notes.title: Roger, Rayleigh & Garp have officially entered the roster!
notes.content:
Yet another blaze of glory. Their time to shine isn't over yet. Play as Gol D. Roger, Rayleigh (Roger Pirates First Mate) and Garp (Hero of the Marines), the three of them in their youth forms.

[previewyoutube=YrvIdzZQeEo;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the characters of the One Piece: Legend Dawn Pack DLC:
 Gol D. Roger, captain of the Roger Pirates. 
Even held the title of Pirate King and possessed the One Piece. He is considered one of the strongest pirates of all time, an unstoppable force!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/b2ec323fb4a2e8e5cab3c2e69a16b3c264af6e6b.png
 Rayleigh (Roger Pirates First Mate) is a highly skilled swordsman. 
And the cunning commander of the Rogers Pirates crew as the First Mate of Gol D. Roger.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/2c479f6e0f1392648d6d903eeae0b3c858e9d1d6.png
 Garp (Hero of the Marines), who is the long-time respected rival of Gol D. Roger. 
He is a formidable fighter in hand-to-hand combat.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/1d5c07b83d9e5fdcf18e662a3712eaea20ba538b.png
As part of the Character Pass 2, a new episode pack called “Path of the King of the Pirates & Soul Map 3” is also available.

Live up to the name of the "Pirate King"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449171/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Legend_Dawn_Pack/

notes.title: Uncover new adventures with Uta, Shanks, and Koby!
notes.content:
New characters for new adventures! Meet the worldwide famous singer Uta and her adoptive father - the famous Red-Haired Shanks. Koby is also here to complete the DLC line-up with his leader role in the Marines.

[previewyoutube=fLYJh0MBtfc;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the characters of the One Piece Film: Red Pack DLC:
 Uta (Film: Red): Shanks’ adoptive daughter and a childhood friend of Luffy’s.
She is now a worldwide famous singer residing on Elegia island and seeks to start a new genesis, free from the hands of the pirates, whom she despises. Armed with her beautiful voice and the powers from the Sing-Sing Fruit, she can activate her Uta World and attack by sending the musical notes and confections she creates bouncing around. She can also transform into the Uta Knight and fly freely around the battlefield.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/419fa53a2a250153821bee03d9a6fcb9134ef277.png
 Shanks (Film: Red): Red-Haired Shanks has never worn his name better than now, as he returns as a playable character. 
Shanks is a skilled swordsman and powerful Haki user. Years after leaving his adoptive daughter on Elegia, he comes back to attempt to save her and the island from a tragic end.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/8707b8897c10d9959c3b9239b3fbe1de2645e849.png
 Koby (Film: Red): Once a shy and fearful soldier, he has come a long way to become a respected leader in the Marines. 
His active role in the SWORD unit will lead him to Elegia island to investigate Uta’s influence on its inhabitants. Koby mainly fights hand-to-hand using the Six Powers. Landing his most powerful attacks will increase morale and enhance support attacks.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/791b2d0a600539f164162ca404fb7d224f838340.png

Alongside this DLC, the Additional Episode 2 DLC, titled “Koby’s Combat Chronicles & Soul Map 2”, releases today as well to play in single player. This new content is available as part of the Additional Episode pack. 

And lastly, as the characters fight off waves of enemies, players can listen along to the One Piece Film: Red soundtrack with the One Piece Film: Red Anime Song Pack, the third DLC available for purchase today. The movie’s soundtrack can be chosen from the settings, in the battle preparation screen, right before jumping into action.

Sail into battle, pirates – the Grand Line awaits! 🏴‍☠️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458610/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Character_Pass_2/

notes.title: Play as Luffy in his Gear Five form in ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4!
notes.content:
ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 lets you relive one of the most epic ONE PIECE arc with The Battle of Onigashima Pack, with three characters joining the roster of the game. 

[previewyoutube=xYnRK0VzgIA;full][/previewyoutube]

Focused on the Battle of Onigashima, this DLC will introduce the following characters:
 Luffy (Onigashima Battle) Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates In a mortal fight against Kaido, the tyrant emperor ruling over Wano Country, Luffy awakens the power of the devil's fruit, transforming into Gear Five, his strongest level yet. Use the Gear Five special move with “Luffy (Onigashima Battle)” to transform temporarily and play using the Gear Five form!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/19526f424c5e8800f206c7b45000d8137f3b0079.png
 Kaido (Onigashima Battle) Human-Beast Form of Kaido Has the ability of “Fish-Fish Fruit, Mythical Zoan, Model: Azure Dragon” covering him with scales and increasing his strength. His attacks are defined by the immense destructive power of his Haki and his iron mace. Use special moves and combos to attack, without giving the opponent a chance to retaliate. During aerial attacks, Kaido can attack multiple enemies at once in his Dragon Form.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/88b67d6245b4dc84358ac60674415c406ccc01a2.png
 Yamato, son of Kaido Also available in this pack. Yamato uses his giant mace to deliver a wide range of attacks. He can also change to his Human-Beast form, using quick combos and ice attacks to freeze enemies in place.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/cc35ce12b401933f0171fd0f511972e4fe5397c1.png

The Battle of Onigashima Pack is available now and part of the Character Pass 2. The Character Pass 2 also includes the Character Packs 5 and 6 that will be revealed later. Owners of the Character Pass 2 also get access to Onigashima Battle Law Costume as a bonus item.

"Take this seriously, I'll defeat you all!"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458610/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Character_Pass_2/

notes.title: Save issues
notes.content:
Hello Players, One Piece Pirate Warriors 4 is now available, and we’d like to thank you all for your support.

Save Error
We regret that some of you are experiencing saving issues.
A patch is on the way, meanwhile we invite players affected by this issue to try the fix below:

1. Right-click on 'ONE PIEC PIRATE WARRIORS 4' in the Steam Client, then navigate to 'Manage' -> 'Browse Local Files', and right-click on OPPW4.EXE, and choose 'Properties' -> 'Compatibility', and check 'Run this program as administrator', then click 'Apply'.
2. Start 'ONE PIEC PIRATE WARRIORS 4' via the Steam Client, and play until you receive the 'Failed to save' error.
3. Go to 'C:\Users' (Change 'C' to whichever drive letter Windows uses)
4. Find a folder named 'Ïîëüçîâàòåëü' or similar, then navigate to the 'AppData' folder inside
5. Find the 'Local', which should contain the 'BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment'
6. Copy the 'BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment' folder to 'C:\Users\ [Your Username] \AppData\Local', resulting in a folder path similar to 'C:\Users\ [Your Username] \Appdata\Local\BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment'

Not enough space
In case you get *not enough space to save* issue - you can try to fix this either by freeing some space on a drive where your *Users* folder is located ( and Windows as well usually ), or Right-Click on your game in steam library - Properties - Local Files - Verify Integrity of Game Files. It should work in most cases.
